name: petpassage
description: Pet relocation planner: personalised checklist, timeline and airline options for moving a cat or dog between countries.

scripts.start: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.db:reset: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false npm run seed:build && wrangler d1 execute petpassage --local --file db/schema.sql --yes && wrangler d1 execute petpassage --local --file db/generated/seed.sql --yes
scripts.db:reset:remote: npm run seed:build && wrangler d1 execute petpassage --remote --file db/schema.sql --yes && wrangler d1 execute petpassage --remote --file db/generated/seed.sql --yes
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run seed:build && wrangler d1 execute petpassage --remote --file db/generated/seed.sql --yes
scripts.setup-sql: npm run seed:build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync('db/setup-all.sql','-- One-paste setup for the Cloudflare D1 Console: schema + data. Regenerate with npm run setup-sql.\n'+fs.readFileSync('db/schema.sql','utf8')+'\n'+fs.readFileSync('db/generated/seed.sql','utf8'))"
